'''Test Subject''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in {{2|Glory}}. It has three phases, reviving twice with increasing HP and new powers.

When reduced to 0 HP again, it revives into Phase 3.

== Notes ==
* Each of Test Subject's phases will lose all status effects when transitioning to the next phase, including the {{BD2|Strength}} gained from {{BD2|Enrage}} in the first phase.
* Cards with on-kill or {{KW2|Fatal}} triggers ({{C2|Feed}}, {{C2|The Hunt}}, {{C2|Knockout Blow}}, {{C2|Sunder}}, and {{C2|Hand of Greed}}) will trigger successfully during ''any'' of the Test Subject's phases.
** Because the Test Subject is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} in Act 3, after which there are no opportunities to spend {{KW2|Gold}} or earn card rewards, {{C2|Feed}}, {{C2|Knockout Blow}}, and {{C2|Sunder}} are the only cards with an on-kill or {{KW2|Fatal}} trigger that matters.
* After Test Subject loses all its HP in a phase, it cannot be targeted by any cards until it revives into the next phase.
** Cards with no targets can still be played, including Attack cards that hit all enemies or random enemies (such as {{C2|Sword Boomerang}} or {{C2|Sweeping Beam}}), but they will deal no damage. All other possible effects will still occur (for instance, {{C2|Sweeping Beam}} will still draw a card).

== Trivia ==
* Each phase of the Test Subject's boss battle is based on an Elite enemy from ''Slay the Spire'':
** Phase 1's {{BD2|Enrage}} buff is shared with the Act 1 Elite {{M|Gremlin Nob}}. The Test Subject's claws and back spikes also resemble the Gremlin Nob's horns.
** Phase 2's {{BD2|Painful Stabs}} buff is shared with the Act 2 Elite {{M|Book of Stabbing}}.
** Phase 3's {{BD2|Nemesis}} buff is identical to the ability of the Act 3 Elite {{M|Nemesis}}, and its icon depicts the mask worn by Nemesis.
* '''Test Subject''' starts each save as '''Test Subject #C8''' with the number increasing by 2 each time it's killed.
